Richard in one boat-sale advertisement; Glasgow is Fitzpatrick’s patent-agency city in the next column. Original viewer excludes the surname interpretation.
Original page names the vessel St. Andrew, wrecked after the hurricane at St. Christopher’s. Andrew is a ship name, not a Glasgow forename.
Original lost-letter advertisement names Andrew Millar. Glasgow is the merchant’s city, not his surname.
Original incumbrance notice gives Lennox’s city, not a Glasgow surname. The Lisnagaver notice on the same page concerns Thomas Stott and John Hamilton and is a separate proceeding.
